card.name: Finding or contacting a provider
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about finding, calling or being referred to a doctor or specialist, such as 'in your town', 'call for an appointment', 'refer you'. Also a few other job or employer phrases.

modes.label: Finding a local specialist
modes.description: Words in 'find a ... in your town/area' directions to locate a professional.
modes.example: Find a local Gastroenterologist<< in>> your town Why does reflux lary

modes.label: Calling or referral
modes.description: Words in phrases about booking an appointment or being referred to a doctor.

modes.label: Changing employers
modes.description: Words in phrases about workers changing jobs or employers.
modes.example: for workers<< when>> they change employers.

card.writes: It lowers hiring and hire words, so the model is steered away from continuing with employment terms.
card.plain: It responds to phrases about finding or being sent to a doctor, and also to phrases about workers changing jobs.
